paragraphs.text: Squid is a creature type used for cards that depict marine cephalopods that feature eight small tentacular arms and two large tentacles.
Unlike the closely related octopus , squids have hard spines that define their distinct mantled heads. They tend to flock within large schools, although larger versions may be solitary.

Not to be confused with octopuses , nautili , krakens or the sentient Cephalid . Squid creatures have been the smallest of the lot, with the giant squid being supplanted by the kraken in the gigantic mollusk space.
Squids are mainly blue -aligned, and most squids are mono- blue . The only multicolored squids are Cephopod Sentry in white-blue and Sela, Deck Boss in blue-red .
The first card printed with the type was the Squid Horror Chasm Skulker added in Magic 2015 .

Modern Horizons added the Squid Illusion Oneirophage , and Zendikar Rising added Skyclave Squid with no additional types. Phyrexia: All Will Be One added Cephalopod Sentry , an artifact Phyrexian squid.
The first anthropomorphic squid was added with Sala, Deck Boss in Alchemy: Aetherdrift .

Fylamarid from Tempest , Sand Squid from Mercadian Masques , and Gulf Squid from Prophecy were all printed as Beasts . With the introduction of the Squid type during Grand Creature Type Update , they were errataed to Squid Beast. This retroactively makes Fylamarid the first Squid in the game.
Squids can be found throughout the Multiverse.

At least one squid-folk arrived with the Chordatans to Avishkar 's coastal regions, having traveled via an instanced Omenpath . Little is known about them and whether their home plane is the same as the other Keelhaulers .

Humanoid squid-folk live on Nauctis . Their clothing usually consists of long, flowing clothes that resemble squid head shape, with vents in the fabric to help obscure their forms, accompanied by rounded jewelry.
